comment: Perfboard layout (PT2399 with an LM358 LFO) with the bare underside, a colour wiring diagram and an etched PCB; counted from the populated board and confirmed against the diagram. The regulator is drawn on the board as a TO-92 with only its pins (O G I) lettered; the wiring diagram names it 7805. LED1 sits on the board, LED2 is a bi-color LED on leads at the board edge.
uncertain: Regulator at the right edge (rows I-K): the board shows only pin letters O G I on a TO-92 outline; the value 7805 comes from the wiring diagram, so a 78L05 is probably what is meant
